thread:
ana: Quick heads-up from today's shadow run: v5.1-int4 vs v5.0-fp16. Overall OK but 'long-thread' slice shows a repeatable dip. Need an anchored canary rule before any split.

 pete: numbers?

 ana: control 11.2k, variant 2.8k. overall mrr -0.7%; long-thread (>=1500 tokens) mrr -5.3%. bootstrap 95% lower = -0.044.

 cho: That smells like KV-merge / truncation. Do we have top pairs?

 ana: I uploaded top_150_pairs.csv to /artifacts/canary/2755554321/. ~35% show prompt suffix clipping.

 samir: Suggestion: CI-driven gate + per-slice minima + ensemble requirement. Minimal policy draft:

```
canary_policy:
  global_min_samples: 1000
  per_slice_min:
    long-thread: 500
  comparator: bootstrap_95_lower
  metrics:
    - mrr: rel_abort_threshold: -0.03
    - accept_rate: rel_abort_threshold: -0.02
  sustained_windows: 3
  window_sec: 1800
  auto_rollback: require_both_metrics
```

 ana: Also add a quick hallucination proxy: response_entropy and avg_len. If entropy drops >20% + mrr down >2% -> immediate hold.

 pete: For small slices, prefer human review. Add per-slice auto_rollback_allowed flag.

 samir: Good. Implementation note: Optimize has /eval/bootstrap — use lower bound <= threshold as trigger. Also add hysteresis: if recovered within 2 windows, suppress rollback and escalate. Add cooldown 4h after rollback.

 canary-bot: [system] I can run dry-shadow runs and post artifacts. I will schedule a dry-canary for 2024-02-10T09:00:00Z and create policy draft "int4-anchored-ensemble-v1". Confirm?

 cho: Confirm. Action items: ana attach csv + examples, pete update policy PR with auto_rollback flags, samir wire /eval/bootstrap comparator, cho run token-diff on top_150_pairs and annotate truncation cases, canary-bot run dry-canary and post artifacts.

 ana: Thanks all. Keep promotion locked until gate is in place. :lock:
